Chapter 6252: Be More Civil

Chapter 6252: Be More Civil

She was looking up at an ordinary youth. Not only did he look like a mortal, he was virtually one. Behind him was a diverse group. They had decent cultivation but nothing shocking.

Others found their appearance strange since a girl and a mortal shouldn't be here. Thus, they assumed they were brought by the cultivators next to them.

"Why not?" Li Qiye glanced at the budding leaf and smiled.

"Then let's go." The girl jumped excitedly.

"Don't, it is filled with tribulation flames, you will die." A cultivator kindly warned them.

Bronze-blade and Coldblade wondered where this girl came from since she wasn't with the group previously.

"Just let them commit suicide if they are tired of living." An expert remarked.

Some shared a similar sentiment while staring at the group with disdain, thinking they were ignorant.

Orchidcore and the others smiled wryly since they had no part in this. Li Qiye was the one who brought them here.

"What are you looking at, little juniors? You all know nothing, these pitiful tribulation flames can't do anything to our young noble." The monarch glared back at them.

"Do you know what tribulation flames are?" Someone retorted.

"Yes, and they aren't shit. Our young noble can devour the heaven, let alone these tiny flames." The monarch strongly barked back.

"Okay, stop messing with them." Li Qiye smiled and shook his head at the deliberate act.

"Young Noble, I'm just speaking the truth. It's a shame that these brats are so blind to your greatness." The monarch declared.

Although he spoke the truth, others found his words grating.

"Ignorant frogs below, unaware of the vast sky above." The proud Skyraiser Crown Prince couldn't help commenting.

"Perfectly said, but the frog in this case is you, junior." The monarch responded, prompting the crown prince to turn red with anger.

"Stop instigating." Princess Chen pulled the monarch's sleeve and said: "He's the successor of Skyraiser Dynasty, a pseudo-emperor."

"A pseudo-emperor can't get into the young noble's eyes, no different than an insect." The monarch said with disdain, offending not just the pseudo-emperors but the whole crowd.

Only two outsiders didn't mind - Bronze-blade who shook his head and smiled while Coldblade showed no emotion.

"Such arrogance." Ruyi Monarch snorted.

"Alright, enough instigation." Li Qiye smiled.

"Young Noble, I am warning them out of the goodness of my heart, I just want them to open their eyes." The monarch laughed.

"Watch your mouth when you speak, less chance of an unexpected death." The crown prince released his intimidating aura.

"Do you want to die?" The girl in Li Qiye's embrace became irate and raised her cute fist after sensing the aura: "Disrespect the ancestor and I will exterminate your clan."

Her fierce demeanor and innocent voice shocked the crowd. Was the young generation so fierce now?

"Little girls are like this nowadays?" Someone whispered.

That old man's haughty demeanor was one thing, but this girl was just as overbearing.

Orchidcore and his peers became startled. They nearly forgot her identity due to her cute appearance. She was an ancestor of Desolate Frontier and had the authority to end a pseudo-emperor's clan.

"Hmph." The crown prince scowled, restraining himself from arguing with a little girl.

"Enough playing around, let's go take a look." Li Qiye patted her head before pointing at the leaf.

"Okay then." The girl cheered and forgot about the incident.

"Young Noble, you must be careful." Bronze-blade said: "This tree was killed and filled to the brim with tribulation flames. They are stronger the closer we get to the tree."

"Don't worry about it. If any of you wishes to go down for dao comprehension, you should ask our young noble nicely about tagging along." The monarch laughed, actually being nice to the old man.

Alas, others took it as an insult. Why would cultivators ask a mortal for help? The whole thing was ridiculous.

"Does he not know the pseudo-emperors are exercising patience and benevolence by not killing them?" A crowd member said.

"This guy won't live past this event." Another said.

"Tagging along?" Bronze-blade froze for a moment, not knowing whether the monarch was serious or otherwise.

"This is your fortune, others can only dream about it." The monarch said.

"Know your limit, you cannot handle the power of the tribulation flames but feel free to go reincarnate." Skyraiser Crown Prince remarked.

"Wow, you are something else, brat. It was a miracle for someone as dumb as you becoming a pseudo-emperor." The monarch said.

"Be more civil when you speak." Ruyi Monarch interjected.

"Finding me annoying when I'm trying to guide you on the right path? Fine, just refrain from antagonizing our young noble lest risk clan extermination." The monarch said.
